# Meetings at Ridgeview Center

Ridgeview Center is a purpose-built conference venue on the edge of the business park, surrounded by landscaped gardens and walking trails. It is designed for organisations that want a calm, focused setting away from the distractions of the city centre.

## Spaces

The center offers a main auditorium with tiered seating, eight breakout rooms of different sizes and an outdoor terrace for receptions in warmer months. All rooms have natural light, adjustable climate control and high-speed wireless internet.

FACT: Ridgeview Center charges 9000 dollars per day for the auditorium.
FACT: Ridgeview Center auditorium seats 320 guests.
FACT: Ridgeview Center provides free parking for 250 cars.

## Technology

The auditorium includes a projection system, stage lighting and wireless microphones. A technician can be booked for an additional hourly fee to manage audio, recording and live streaming. Breakout rooms are fitted with large displays and video conferencing equipment.

## Food and drink

Ridgeview Center works with an approved catering partner that offers breakfast, lunch and refreshment packages. Menus include vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options as standard, and the terrace can host an evening reception with drinks and canapes.

## Getting here

The center is twenty five minutes from the city centre by car. A shuttle bus can be arranged from the nearest train station for groups of more than fifty attendees. The building is fully accessible, with ramps, lifts and accessible restrooms throughout.

## Reservations

A twenty percent deposit secures your dates. Ridgeview Center offers a reduced rate for multi-day bookings and for events held between November and February.
